brief:
Palestinian children gathered along Gaza's coast for swimming lessons, finding momentary relief from the psychological toll of ongoing conflict, Al Jazeera English reported. The lessons provide a rare break from the stress and displacement many young residents have endured.

Organizers of the program aim to support children's mental health during a period marked by violence and displacement. Swimming offers both physical activity and an opportunity for normalcy in circumstances constrained by war.

title: Gaza swimming lessons offer children respite from war's trauma
